descriptions.interaction: Use IDE completion to traverse classes/properties and restrict a path query;generate host-language types;query RDF objects and create/manipulate typed instances
descriptions.guidance: Intensional semantics/type information supplies context-specific NPQL completion and static checking while exploring an unfamiliar RDF schema
descriptions.visualisation: Programming IDE text editor with autocomplete/type panels;no graph visualization described
